name: @sig-net/midnight-signer
description: The central signet Compact contract on Midnight: integrating contracts notify it of their signature requests through signBidirectional, which emits a contract event the MPC polls. The MPC posts its responses to @sig-net/midnight-responder. src/index.ts is the curated export surface.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ls src/managed/keys/*.prover >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'signet-signer build: no prover keys in src/managed/keys, run `yarn compile:zk` first (compile uses --skip-zk)' >&2; exit 1; } && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/managed && cp -R src/managed/contract src/managed/compiler src/managed/zkir src/managed/keys dist/managed/
